name: Lightning Arrow Deadeye
summary: League-start bow build. One skill in the body armour, a physical bow with attack speed, and gem levels carry the damage: nothing here needs a unique, so the same gear works on day one of a solo league. It is the second build the pipeline proves, and the first that is not a minion one.

pros.text: Fast clear: a single arrow covers a pack at range.
Strong league starter with no required unique.
Critical strikes and added lightning scale hard into maps.
Ranged play keeps you out of most retaliation range.
The filter and the build share the same bow and quiver bases.
Gear upgrades are easy to compare because the rare bow is the main damage slot.

cons.text: Evasion is the defensive layer; a bad streak of hits ends the map.
Single-target needs investment beyond the clear setup.
Critical gear is expensive relative to a plain resistance set.
Physical burst and spell damage are the common death causes.
Mana is tight before leech and reduced cost are online.
No built-in sustain; leech or life flasks have to cover it.

summary.text: Lightning Arrow Deadeye is a fast bow build that measures 84.6k at red maps and 132.0k at pinnacle. A rare bow, added lightning and critical strikes carry the damage; no unique is required.

leveling.text: Level with Lightning Arrow and added lightning, then add the critical supports as they unlock. The first checkpoint measures 383 life and 75 damage; the second measures 542. Keep a mana flask until leech and reduced cost are online.

maps.text: At red maps the build measures 84.6k damage, 28251 effective life and 8009 physical max hit. Keep the bow current, cap the elemental resistances, and let the filter hide the rest.

bossing.text: Pinnacle measures 132.0k damage with 41636 effective life and 10791 physical max hit. Keep the mark up, fire from outside slam range, and do not treat evasion as a guarantee.
